business_problem: AT&T needed to route customers more accurately, increase autonomous issue containment, and make virtual assistants feel more personal instead of forcing users through repetitive phone trees and stateless support interactions.
solution_summary: AT&T combined BigQuery with Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience to build a more contextual support stack across voice and chat channels. BigQuery analyzes customer history so the contact center can route each person to the right path without relying on rigid menus, improving front-end containment before a conversation even begins. Once the interaction starts, Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience handles more complex issues naturally and retains up to sixty days of conversational memory, which means customers do not have to restate context every time they return or move between support scenarios. This memory layer also helps AT&T use the same conversational foundation for sales, service, and troubleshooting. The result is a support experience that resolves more calls autonomously, routes customers faster, and feels more continuous and personalized than traditional telecom-service flows.
